penalties.impact: The sum of Rs. 58,812/- is paid towards the compounding of contravention of Regulation 3 of the Foreign Exchange Management (Realisation, Repatriation and Surrender of Foreign Exchange) Regulations, 2000, notified under Notification No. 09/RB-2000 dated May 03, 2000, as amended from time to time, pursuant to the compounding order received from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) dated June 8, 2026. timeline.summary: 360 ONE WAM's step-down subsidiary received in-principle approval from IFSCA to act as a retail Fund Management Entity at GIFT City.

360 ONE WAM's wholly owned subsidiary 360 ONE Alternates Asset Management approved and signed an SPA to buy of Quark Solar Private Limited for ₹9.39 Cr in cash; to act as an operating entity for planned renewables fund SPVs.
360 ONE WAM and its subsidiary 360 ONE Prime received income tax assessment demands totaling ₹336.14 Cr for the block period from April 2018 to March 2025.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,115.47 Cr, net profit ₹288.74 Cr (+15.7% YoY).
360 ONE WAM reported FY26 consolidated PAT of ₹1,225 Cr (+20.7% YoY) on total revenue of ₹3,144 Cr, with total AUM reaching ₹6,74,492 Cr.
360 ONE WAM LIMITED’s **Rohit Bhase** (ACS: 21409) posted earnings call audio/video recordings on April 21, 2026, per SEBI’s Regulation 30.
360 ONE WAM submitted monitoring agency reports for Q4 FY26 showing zero fund utilization during the quarter.
360 ONE WAM hosted its Q4FY26 earnings call, reporting ARR AUM of ₹3.12 lakh Cr and FY26 PAT of ₹1,225 Cr.
360 ONE WAM completed the acquisition of Quark Solar as a step-down subsidiary on April 30, 2026.
360 ONE AMC received SEBI No Objection letter for mutual fund activities in GIFT City on May 21, 2026.
Yatin Shah, Karan Bhagat, and 14 other promoter entities declared no new share encumbrances under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) for FY2026.
On July 16, 2026, 360 ONE WAM held its Q1FY27 earnings call, reporting PAT of ₹330 Cr (+14.8% YoY) and ARR AUM of ₹3.42 lakh Cr (+19% YoY), with cost-to-income guided to 49-49.5% by Q4FY27.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,143.83 Cr, net profit ₹300.11 Cr (-4.9% YoY).
On October 15, 2026, 360 ONE WAM reported Q2FY27 total revenue of ₹853 Cr (+4.8% YoY) and PAT of ₹302 Cr (-4.4% YoY), with ARR AUM at ₹3.53 lakh Cr and ARR retention at 79 bps.
360 ONE WAM submitted monitoring agency reports for its preferential warrant issues for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.
360 ONE WAM LIMITED hosted audio and video recordings of its earnings call held on October 15, 2026 on its website.
On October 15, 2026, 360 ONE WAM reported Q2FY27 revenue from operations of ₹896 Cr and PAT of ₹302 Cr, with total AUM crossing ₹9 lakh Cr.
360 ONE WAM allotted 2.05 Cr equity shares to UBS AG upon full conversion of warrants, raising balance funds of ₹1,583.85 Cr.
